subject: maths
question: Find the volume (in cm³) of the hemisphere whose diameter measures 14 cm (Use π = (22/7) ).
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the hemisphere = 14 cm

Radius of the hemisphere (r) = 14/2 = 7 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a hemisphere = (2/3) π r³

**Calculation:**

Volume of the hemisphere

Volume = (2/3) π r³

π = 22/7

r = 7 cm

→ Volume = (2/3) × (22/7) × 7³

→ Volume = (2/3) × (22/7) × 343

→ Volume = (2/3) × 22 × 49

→ Volume = (2 × 22 × 49)/3

→ Volume = 2156/3

**The volume of the hemisphere is 2156/3 cm³.**
